error.compare_data_versions: the runs use different data versions ({a} and {b}); compare runs on the same data version, or two runs of the same scenario
error.hard_delete_has_runs: the scenario has {runs} run(s); it can only be deleted softly
error.last_admin: the last active administrator cannot be disabled or demoted
error.no_baseline: no succeeded baseline run on data {version} yet
error.no_results: the run has no results (not succeeded)
error.only_owner_delete: only the owner or an admin can delete
error.only_owner_edit: only the owner or an admin can edit
error.only_owner_run: only the owner or an admin can run it
error.only_starter_cancel: only who started the run or an admin
error.password_common: this password is on the list of commonly used passwords; choose another one
error.password_short: password must have at least {length} characters
error.samples_mismatch: samples file of run {run} does not match its recorded SHA-256: it was damaged or changed after the run
error.samples_missing: samples file of run {run} is missing: {file}
error.samples_other_run: samples file {file} belongs to run {other}, not {run}
error.scenario_mismatch: the scenario does not match the data
error.scenario_mismatch_in: the scenario does not match data {version}
error.self_demote: you cannot demote or disable yourself
error.too_many_attempts: too many failed sign-in attempts; try again later
recorded.new_edge_closed: new edge {edge} is closed by the same scenario: added, then closed, so no net effect (OQ-30)
run.cancelled_running: Cancelled by a user while running.
run.interrupted: Interrupted: the worker ({worker}) stopped while this run was running ({when}). No results were stored. Start the run again.
run.queued_other_code: This run was queued for code {queued}, but the platform now runs code {current} (it was upgraded or rebuilt before the run started). The run cannot be reproduced as recorded. Start the run again.
run.queued_other_model: This run was queued for model {model} {queued}, but the platform now has {current}. Start the run again.
run.reuse_refused: An earlier run with the same inputs was not reused because its results file failed the integrity check ({details}). This run computes the results again.
run.timed_out: Stopped: the job ran longer than the maximum runtime of {limit:g} s set for '{kind}' jobs (SOLIDARITYNODE_JOB_MAX_RUNTIME_SECONDS). No results were stored.
scenario.edge_missing_in: edge {edge}: closed or missing in data {version}
scenario.edge_mode_missing: edge {edge}: has no {mode} travel time to change
scenario.edge_time_not_positive: edge {edge}: {mode} travel time would not stay positive; to close a road use closed edges
scenario.facility_missing: facility {facility}: closed or missing in the data version
scenario.facility_missing_in: facility {facility}: closed or missing in data {version}
scenario.population_negative: unit {unit}, group {group}: population would become negative
